candidates.description: These tokens represent subword fragments and characters from North Indian scripts, specifically Devanagari.
This feature vector represents characters and subword fragments from the Hindi Devanagari script.
This vector activates on common Hindi sub-word tokens and character sequences.
These tokens represent subword units, suffixes, or character n-grams commonly found in Devanagari script for Hindi or related Indic languages.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign suffixes and character combinations often found in word endings.
This vector activates for Hindi vowel characters and vowel sign modifiers, particularly those involving independent vowels and dependent matras.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi subword tokens, particularly oblique forms and inflections of pronouns and demonstratives (such as 'इस' and 'इन').
This vector activates on various Hindi character sequences and syllables containing the vowel sign 'ा' (ā).
This feature vector represents Devanagari script characters and syllables used in Hindi and related Indic languages.
This feature vector activates on mixed alphanumeric sequences, non-Latin script fragments, and programming syntax tokens.
